methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Anvil Robotics is a frontier-stage entrant in Robotics & Manufacturing founded by Mike Xia. The valuation universe comprises 10 sector peers: one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. A search for same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Robotics & Manufacturing sector yielded zero datapoints meeting those criteria. The private peer set of eight companies does not contain sufficient narrow-filter matches (need ≥3) to support a reliable median or mean multiple derivation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material misstatement risk given the heterogeneity of robotics subsegments and development stages represented in the broader comp set.

Without applicable triangulation methods supported by sufficient granular data, a quantitative valuation range cannot be responsibly derived at this time. Key uncertainties include: stage and financing history (undisclosed), specific subsector focus within robotics and manufacturing, and comparable company financial metrics and recent transaction terms. Forward analysis would require either: disclosure of Anvil's stage and prior rounds, identification of additional narrow-filter peers, or transaction/funding data from the existing eight private comparables.
